approach.label: ENGINEERED FOR THE DRIVE
approach.body: Every component is designed around the same idea: precise engineering, purposeful form, and a character that belongs on the road.

hero.label: AUTOMOTIVE EQUIPMENT
hero.body: Ronas Corduene creates automotive equipment where engineering, design and character meet.

paragraphs: We believe automotive equipment should never feel like an afterthought.
Every detail has a purpose. From the shape of a component to the way it interacts with the road, our approach is built around precision, simplicity and intent.
Ronas is about creating equipment that belongs naturally on the vehicle — not simply adding to it.

values.title: DESIGN
values.body: Clean proportions, deliberate surfaces and a visual language designed to complement the vehicle.

values.title: ENGINEERING
values.body: Every solution begins with function, precision and the demands of real-world driving.

values.title: CHARACTER
values.body: Equipment should change the presence of a vehicle without losing what made it special in the first place.

closing.body: We build for the people who see their vehicle as more than transportation. Every component is an opportunity to make the drive feel more intentional.

hero.label: ENGINEERING WITH PURPOSE
hero.body: Production leftovers don't always have to become waste. We redirect offcuts and material scraps into mobility equipment for stray animals — designed, fabricated and fitted with the same discipline as everything we build.

paragraphs: Every production run leaves something behind: trimmed carbon, off-cut aluminium, short lengths of tube, surplus hardware.
Instead of sending it to scrap, we treat it as stock. The same engineering that shapes our aero and performance parts is redirected into equipment that restores movement.

values.title: EFFICIENCY
values.body: Material that already exists is material that does not need to be produced again.

values.title: PRECISION
values.body: Off-cuts are measured, sorted and specified with the same tolerances as any other component.

values.title: PURPOSE
values.body: Engineering earns its value when it changes what someone is able to do.

process.intro: The same workshop, the same machines, a different outcome.

steps.title: MATERIAL
steps.body: Leftover carbon, aluminium, tube and hardware are collected at the end of each build.

steps.title: SELECTION
steps.body: Pieces are inspected, measured and graded for structural suitability.

steps.title: DESIGN
steps.body: Each unit is drawn around the animal's size, weight and range of motion.

steps.title: FABRICATION
steps.body: Cutting, forming, bonding and finishing happen on the same tooling as our performance parts.

steps.title: MOBILITY
steps.body: The finished equipment is fitted, adjusted and handed over ready to move.

examples.intro: Small, purpose-built devices that give animals back their independence.

items.title: ANIMAL WHEELCHAIRS
items.body: Lightweight frames and rolling supports sized to the animal, for rear-limb or full-body mobility.

items.title: MOBILITY AIDS
items.body: Harnesses, slings and support frames that stabilise movement during recovery or long-term impairment.

items.title: CUSTOM SUPPORT
items.body: One-off braces, prosthetics and fittings designed around a specific animal and its specific need.
